description: Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services is a data repository run by INCOIS, Ministry of Earth Sciences, India. INCOIS runs the Indian tsunami early warning centre and provides ocean state forecasts, storm-surge, wave and high-wave alert products and coastal hazard information, with data available on request. Coverage: Indian Ocean rim and Indian coast. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as html, netcdf; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("no page title") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support coastal hazard studies for Indian ports and coastal infrastructure. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
